lines.zh: 我在河底的暗处滑行，须先探路。
lines.en: I glide through the dark riverbed, whiskers feeling the way.

lines.zh: 泥很软，我的肚子陷进去半寸。
lines.en: The mud is soft and my belly sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 我贴着桥墩走，那里水流慢。
lines.en: I hug the bridge pier where the current slows.

lines.zh: 夜里我才出来，白天躲在石缝。
lines.en: I come out at night and hide in rock gaps by day.

lines.zh: 我的须扫过草根，摸到一只虾。
lines.en: My barbels sweep the roots and find a shrimp.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，泥从身后翻起来。
lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly and mud boils up behind.

lines.zh: 这条河就我一个，我走得很散漫。
lines.en: I am the only one in this river, so I wander loose.

lines.zh: 我从深潭游到浅滩，一路低头。
lines.en: I travel from deep pool to shallows, head down.

lines.zh: 我的皮没有鳞，蹭过石头不留声。
lines.en: My skin has no scales and rasps silently over stone.

lines.zh: 水凉了，我往深处挪。
lines.en: The water cools and I move deeper.

lines.zh: 我绕过一张旧渔网，很小心。
lines.en: I ease around an old fishing net, very carefully.

lines.zh: 淤泥里味道最浓，我就在那儿走。
lines.en: The silt carries the strongest smell; I travel there.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但从不迷路。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 一整天我只挪了十几步。
lines.en: In a whole day I move barely a dozen paces.

lines.zh: 我沿着河底的凹槽游过去。
lines.en: I follow the groove along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 须碰到石头，我就改道。
lines.en: My barbels touch stone, so I turn.

lines.zh: 一尾小鱼闪过，我没去追。
lines.en: A small fish darts by. I don't chase.

lines.zh: 桥下的阴影，我歇一会儿。
lines.en: In the shade under the bridge I rest a while.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥上，须还在轻轻动。
lines.en: I lie on the mud with my whiskers still stirring.

lines.zh: 我发出很低的咕噜声，自己听着。
lines.en: I make a low grunting sound and listen to it.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有别的声音，很好。
lines.en: There is no other sound in the dark; good.

lines.zh: 我用须碰石头，是熟悉的形状。
lines.en: My barbels touch a stone; I know its shape.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，水从嘴里过。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let water pass through.

lines.zh: 我懒得动，连眼睛都半闭。
lines.en: I cannot be bothered to move; even my eyes half close.

lines.zh: 有东西在泥里爬，我不理它。
lines.en: Something crawls in the silt and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，泥被压出个坑。
lines.en: I shift position and press a hollow in the mud.

lines.zh: 水面上的月亮被波纹切碎了。
lines.en: Ripples chop the moonlight into pieces overhead.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔自己的须，尝到泥味。
lines.en: I lick my own barbels and taste mud.

lines.zh: 独自待着最省事。
lines.en: Being alone is the least trouble.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍搁在石上，一动就响。
lines.en: My tail rests on stone and rattles when it moves.

lines.zh: 一整个夜里，我只想吃饱。
lines.en: All night long I want only a full belly.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有人走，等他走远。
lines.en: I hear someone on the bank and wait them out.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到水底，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Your torch reaches the riverbed and I flinch back.

lines.zh: 火光只照到水面，我藏在下面。
lines.en: The torchlight only reaches the surface; I hide below it.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一点，须先露出水面。
lines.en: I rise a little, whiskers breaking the surface first.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我绕着你转。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows and I circle you.

lines.zh: 我认得你的网，那种线很细。
lines.en: I know your net; that kind of line is thin.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来照水，我把头转开。
lines.en: You crouch and shine a light; I turn my head away.

lines.zh: 你把火举高，我依旧贴在泥上。
lines.en: You raise the torch, and I stay flat against the silt.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里比火把更吓人。
lines.en: Your shadow in the water frightens me more than the torch.

lines.zh: 我嘴边的须在试你的味道。
lines.en: The barbels by my mouth are tasting you.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就沉回泥里。
lines.en: You move, and I sink back into the silt.

lines.zh: 你的刀划开我的皮，很滑的一刀。
lines.en: Your blade parts my skin in one slippery cut.

lines.zh: 我疼得翻进泥里，藏起半个身子。
lines.en: Pain rolls me into the silt with half my body hidden.

lines.zh: 我没有鳞，所以每一刀都清楚。
lines.en: I have no scales, so every cut is felt.

lines.zh: 我甩尾退进石缝，泥跟着涌进去。
lines.en: I flick my tail into the gap and mud floods after.

lines.zh: 血在水里散得像一团墨。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water like an ink cloud.

lines.zh: 你又砍了一下，我才真的怕了。
lines.en: You strike again, and only then am I truly afraid.

lines.zh: 我在泥里一动不动，等你走。
lines.en: I stay motionless in the silt until you leave.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我少了一根须。
lines.en: That cut costs me one of my barbels.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪走，往最深的坑里。
lines.en: I creep away toward the deepest hollow.

lines.zh: 伤口在泥里闷着，反而没那么疼。
lines.en: Buried in silt, the wound hurts a little less.

lines.zh: 你丢下的内脏，味道在水里炸开。
lines.en: The offal you drop bursts its smell through the water.

lines.zh: 那团腐肉我闻了很远。
lines.en: I smelled that rotting meat from far away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，须先碰到钩线。
lines.en: I close in slowly, barbels finding the line first.

lines.zh: 明知有钩，腥味还是赢了我。
lines.en: I know the hook is there, and the stink still wins.

lines.zh: 我围着那块肉转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle that piece of meat three times.

lines.zh: 你的手一松，我就冲上去了。
lines.en: Your hand lets go and I lunge for it.

lines.zh: 那味道又酸又香，我很喜欢。
lines.en: That smell is sour and rich, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我把嘴贴上去，先吸一口。
lines.en: I press my mouth to it and suck once.

lines.zh: 水里全是腥味，我分不清方向。
lines.en: The water is all blood-smell and I lose direction.

lines.zh: 吃饱比活着要紧，我就是这么想。
lines.en: A full belly beats staying alive; that is my thinking.

lines.zh: 你踩进泥里，把我压在下面。
lines.en: You step into the mud and pin me underneath.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的腿，滑得像块湿布。
lines.en: I bump your leg and slip past like wet cloth.

lines.zh: 泥被踩塌了，我掉进坑里。
lines.en: The silt collapses underfoot and I drop into a pit.

lines.zh: 你踢起一团泥，我什么也看不见。
lines.en: You kick up silt and I can see nothing.

lines.zh: 我被你挤到石头边，动不了。
lines.en: You crowd me against a stone and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的须被踩了一下，很疼。
lines.en: One of my barbels is stepped on and it hurts.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我才钻出来。
lines.en: You shift back half a step and only then do I slide out.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我贴住了河底。
lines.en: The knock presses me flat against the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水全浑了，我只能靠须走。
lines.en: The water is all mud; I must travel by whisker.

lines.zh: 我撞翻一块石头，它滚到你脚边。
lines.en: I knock a stone loose and it rolls to your feet.

lines.zh: 这条河里还有一个同类，很少见。
lines.en: There is one other of my kind in this river; rare.

lines.zh: 我在石缝口等她，须一直探着。
lines.en: I wait at a rock gap for her, whiskers always probing.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴在泥上，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the mud, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 她用须碰我，我才知道她来了。
lines.en: Her barbels touch me, and I learn she has come.

lines.zh: 我在深潭挖了个浅坑，给她。
lines.en: I scoop a shallow hollow in the deep pool for her.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块沉木游了两圈。
lines.en: We circle the same sunken log twice.

lines.zh: 卵要藏在泥里，才不会被动。
lines.en: The eggs must hide in the silt to stay untouched.

lines.zh: 之后她又走了，我本来也独居。
lines.en: Afterward she leaves again; I live alone anyway.

lines.zh: 水里那点温存，只够一夜。
lines.en: That bit of warmth in the water lasts one night.

lines.zh: 我回到自己的石缝，把坑填平了。
lines.en: I return to my own gap and fill the hollow in.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一块骨头，很顺手。
lines.en: I pick up a bone in my jaw; it fits well.

lines.zh: 有块玻璃沉在泥里，我含着玩。
lines.en: A piece of glass lies in the silt; I mouth it idly.

lines.zh: 我把一枚旧扣子吸进嘴里。
lines.en: I suck an old button into my mouth.

lines.zh: 那东西太硬，我吐了两次。
lines.en: The thing is too hard; I spit it out twice.

lines.zh: 我拖着半只螃蟹往石缝走。
lines.en: I drag half a crab toward my rock gap.

lines.zh: 水里飘来的布条，被我咬住。
lines.en: A strip of cloth floats past and I take it.

lines.zh: 我含着石头游，好像有用。
lines.en: I swim with a stone in my mouth, as if it helps.

lines.zh: 我试着吞那根鱼骨，卡住了。
lines.en: I try to swallow a fish bone and it sticks.

lines.zh: 泥面上的硬币我碰都不碰。
lines.en: I do not touch the coin lying on the silt.

lines.zh: 拿走一样东西，我就换个地方。
lines.en: Take one thing and I move somewhere else.

lines.zh: 泥里有东西在动，我的须知道了。
lines.en: Something moves in the silt and my barbels know.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙落水，声音很清楚。
lines.en: A frog drops in and the sound is clear.

lines.zh: 我在暗中找到了那只螃蟹。
lines.en: I find the crab in the dark.

lines.zh: 有条鱼在浅水里打转，逃不掉。
lines.en: A fish is turning in the shallows; it cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我转向那股血味。
lines.en: I turn toward that smell of blood.

lines.zh: 水面扑腾了一下，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: Something splashes above and my head lifts at once.

lines.zh: 我摸到一只螺，太硬，不要。
lines.en: I feel a snail; too hard, not worth it.

lines.zh: 那点动静离我不到一尺。
lines.en: The small commotion is less than a foot away.

lines.zh: 我缓缓转身，须先伸过去。
lines.en: I turn slowly and send my barbels ahead.

lines.zh: 猎物没发现泥里还有我。
lines.en: The prey has not noticed there is also me in the mud.

lines.zh: 我跟着那股味，方向不会错。
lines.en: I follow the smell; the direction cannot be wrong.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我的须就偏一点。
lines.en: Each time it moves, my barbels angle slightly.

lines.zh: 水里黑，我不用眼睛也能追。
lines.en: The water is black; I can chase without eyes.

lines.zh: 我把自己沉在它下方，慢慢跟。
lines.en: I drop below it and follow slowly.

lines.zh: 它往石头那边去，我抄了近路。
lines.en: It heads for the stones; I take the shorter way.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等它自己过来。
lines.en: I hold completely still and let it come to me.

lines.zh: 距离一尺，两寸，只剩一口。
lines.en: One foot, two inches, only a mouthful left.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，水流进去了。
lines.en: I open my jaw and the current flows in.

lines.zh: 它忽然停住，我也停住。
lines.en: It suddenly stops, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 它逃的方向正好对着我的嘴。
lines.en: The way it flees is straight into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一口含住它，整只吞下去。
lines.en: I close my mouth around it and swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我咬住螃蟹的腿，壳碎了。
lines.en: I bite the crab's leg and the shell gives.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它压进泥里。
lines.en: I press it down into the silt with my body.

lines.zh: 这一咬没声音，只有泥动。
lines.en: This bite makes no sound, only mud stirring.

lines.zh: 它在我嘴里挣，我不松口。
lines.en: It struggles in my mouth and I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我把它往石头上摔了两下。
lines.en: I slap it against a stone twice.

lines.zh: 吞不下去，我撕成两半。
lines.en: I cannot swallow it, so I tear it in two.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我舔了舔。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I lick at it.

lines.zh: 我退回石缝里慢慢吃。
lines.en: I retreat into my rock gap to eat in peace.

lines.zh: 吃完只剩一点骨头沉底。
lines.en: Afterward only a few bones settle to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我在没有光的河底睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a riverbed without light.

lines.zh: 这条河很浑，正合我意。
lines.en: This river is muddy, which suits me exactly.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，须先伸出。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a rock gap, barbels leading.

lines.zh: 河湾的水深，我就在这儿住下。
lines.en: The bend runs deep, so I settle here.

lines.zh: 上游冲下来的泥盖住了我。
lines.en: Mud washed down from upstream covers me.

lines.zh: 这里只有我一个，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: There is only me here, and I like that.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出来，抖掉一层土。
lines.en: I rise out of the silt and shake off the earth.

lines.zh: 大雨之后水涨了，我进了新水道。
lines.en: After heavy rain the water rose and I entered a new channel.

lines.zh: 我绕着沉木转一圈，认了家。
lines.en: I circle a sunken log once and call it home.

lines.zh: 月亮照不到这里，正好。
lines.en: The moon does not reach down here; perfect.

lines.zh: 火光贴到水面，我往泥里缩。
lines.en: Firelight touches the surface and I shrink into mud.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，在泥地上翻。
lines.en: I am flung ashore and flop on the muddy ground.

lines.zh: 我在水里闷住了，说不通。
lines.en: I am suffocating in water, which makes no sense.

lines.zh: 河底震了一下，我飞了出去。
lines.en: The riverbed jolts and I am thrown clear.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进泥里，就在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow drives into the silt right beside me.

lines.zh: 有光照到河底，我的须全缩了。
lines.en: Light reaches the riverbed and all my barbels curl.

lines.zh: 泥里空了，我连虾都找不到。
lines.en: The silt is empty; I cannot even find shrimp.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，我整条翻过来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and flips me over.

lines.zh: 河底裂开了，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: The riverbed splits and below there is nothing.
